title: Pezzulo & Levin (2015) & Friston, Levin, Sengupta & Pezzulo (2015) Active Inference, Variational Free Energy Minimization, and Homeostatic Anatomical Error-Correction Toward Bioelectric Target Morphology

governing_equations.bioelectric_belief_updating_ode: dmu/dt = -kappa_mu * dF/dmu = kappa_mu * Pi_s * J_g(mu)^T * (s(x) - g(mu)) - kappa_mu * Pi_p * (mu - mu_target)

experimental_regimes.description: Proximal salamander forelimb amputation through the stylopod/humerus (L_0 = 0.20 L^*): large initial sensory prediction error triggers high initial blastema growth velocity that decelerates exponentially and stops strictly at L(T) = L^* = 1.00 (stylopod + zeugopod + autopod restored, F -> 0)

Distal salamander forelimb amputation through the wrist/autopod (L_0 = 0.70 L^*): smaller initial prediction error drives slower blastema outgrowth that converges to the exact same target length L(T) = L^* = 1.00 (level-invariant anatomical equifinality, |L_prox(T) - L_dist(T)| < 1e-4)

Farinella-Ferruzza (1956) / Pezzulo & Levin (2015) ectopic tail-blastema graft onto the flank/shoulder limb field (initial organ identity psi_0 = -1.0 tail, L_0 = 0.35): global body-plan bioelectric prior mu_target = (L^*=1.0, psi^*=+1.0) remodels the grafted tail tissue into a normal limb (psi -> +1.0, L -> 1.00)

Rewritten bioelectric target morphology memory (Pezzulo & Levin 2015 Fig. 4; Durant et al. 2017): transient bioelectric circuit editing shifts the stored target setpoint from mu_target = 1.00 to mu_target' = 1.45 (or 2-headed / ectopic hyper-elongated morph), so post-amputation regeneration converges to L^*' = 1.45 without genomic change

Singer (1952) / Pezzulo & Levin (2015) denervation / sensory-precision blockade negative control (Pi_s = 0): abolishing bioelectric sensory precision eliminates active morphogenetic error-correction (dx/dt = -kappa_a * Pi_s * (x - mu) = 0), arresting the limb stump at L(t) = L_0 = 0.20
